title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ObjectStorageServiceOffering
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ObjectStorageServiceOffering. A digital service available for order and offering object storage capabilities. Subclass of StorageServiceOffering per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the StorageServiceOffering model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ObjectStorageServiceOffering'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

accessAttributes.description: Property. Supported access attributes (i.e. how the data can be accessed: read-only, read-write, append-only, etc). Controlled-vocabulary value (AccessAttribute), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

maximumObjectSize.description: Relationship. Maximum size for objects supported by the service. Links to a MemorySize entity.

objectAPICompatibility.description: Property. Compatibility for third party object storage APIs. Controlled-vocabulary value (StorageAPI), enumeration not resolved in this pass.
